common.name: Name
landing.title:
Let your characters
live beyond the chat.
landing.subtitle:
Bring a character you love into a story that remembers.
Characters express themselves. The world keeps the facts.
landing.localBody: Your characters, conversations and saves stay in your browser.
landing.ownBody: One provider, one key, one model. You are ready to begin.
landing.compatBody: Bring PNG / JSON V2 and V3 character cards and world books.
landing.privacy: We do not host your character content. When you use cloud AI, the selected conversation context is sent directly to your chosen provider.
wizard.title: Three steps into your world
wizard.formats: PNG or JSON · V2 / V3 · up to 32 MB
wizard.original: Your original character content is preserved.
wizard.demo: You can explore the offline demo first. No API key needed.
provider.title: Connect a model
provider.manual: You can also enter a model ID manually
provider.private: Your key is encrypted on this device, never sent to OpenCharacter. Use a separate key with a spending limit.

chat.interrupted: Reply interrupted. You can regenerate it.
chat.editWarning: Editing, deleting or switching this message removes later messages and rewinds related world changes. You can create a branch first.
chat.empty: A new story is waiting for its first words.
action.observePrompt: I quietly look around and notice what you are doing.
action.invitePrompt: I would like to invite you to

world.noEvents: Important moments will leave their mark here.
world.noFacts: No new facts have been recorded yet.
world.pendingHint: Uncertain actions do not automatically change the world.
world.authorNotice: Author action: explicitly define a world fact. Nothing is inferred automatically from character text.
settings.title: Make this world yours
settings.contentLanguage: Changing the interface language does not translate your character.
settings.saveNote: Saves include the character, chat and world, but no API keys or connection secrets. Import creates a new story without overwriting existing data.
settings.persistNote: Browser data can still be cleared manually. Export backups regularly.
settings.installHelp: Browser menu → Install app / Add to home screen.

character.creator: Creator

onboard.action: These actions make your intentions clearer and reduce misunderstandings.

help.title: A little help for your journey
help.gettingBody: Import a PNG / JSON card, choose a provider and enter your key and model ID, then enter the world. The offline example is a good way to explore.
help.worldBody: Facts describe the present; events explain why. Ownership changes after an accepted gift. Unclear replies stay pending. Ordinary small talk does not fill long-term memory.
help.loreBody: In Advanced mode, import or edit world books and use keywords to include relevant lore. Persona describes who you are. Original character content remains preserved.
help.dataBody: Characters, chats and worlds are stored locally. Cloud model requests go directly to your chosen provider. Export saves regularly: clearing browser data or changing the site address may make local records inaccessible.
help.errorsBody: Check the base URL, key and model ID. A web app cannot bypass a provider’s CORS restrictions; choose a browser-compatible endpoint. You can read and export while offline.
help.advancedBody: Advanced mode reveals world books, personas and model parameters. Expert adds context and transaction inspection. Editing or deleting history rewinds later changes; create a branch first.
notice.rejected: The action did not pass world validation. Facts are unchanged.
creator.hint: Start with a blank card or edit your design. Imported originals remain intact. Text drives the story; visuals and music set the mood.
creator.alternates: Alternate greetings (separate with a line containing ---)
creator.promptHint: Use character and user macros in prompts. World lore provides narrative context; it does not automatically create items or committed events.
creator.mediaHint: Images, GIF, WebM and MP4, up to 48 MB per file. Reorder, switch manually or rotate on a timer.
creator.audioHint: Supports browser-playable MP3, WAV, OGG and M4A. Click play in the story to enable music, change tracks or adjust volume. Media is included in world saves.
creator.emptyGreeting: Your story begins with the first words.
creator.decorative: Decoration is optional; text remains central. JSON holds text; use world saves for media.
provider.qwenRegion: The default endpoint is Mainland China. Match the endpoint to your key’s region, workspace and plan.
provider.claudeBrowser: Uses Anthropic Messages directly from the browser. If the endpoint blocks browser requests, use a compatible endpoint you trust.
error.mediaFormat: Unsupported media format. Choose a supported image, video or audio file.
provider.samplingDefault: This protocol/model uses its default sampling settings to avoid unsupported-parameter errors.
error.mediaBudget: The media library is near the save-size limit. Remove some media before adding more.
error.outputLimit: The output budget was exhausted. The reply may be incomplete; increase the output limit before retrying.
error.emptyResponse: The model finished without response text. Reasoning may have consumed the output budget.
action.storeText: Please keep {{item}} for me. I retain ownership.
group.title: Group members
group.hint: Send uses the selected speaker. Reply in order makes one call per active member without automatic action commits. Each uses their own definition and lore. Removing members preserves history and world entities. Up to 12.
group.speaker: Current speaker
error.notPresent: The selected character is absent or muted. Choose another speaker.
compat.extensions: Extension settings are preserved in the original file. SillyTavern scripts, replacement regex and extensions do not execute.
compat.macros: Supported double-brace macros: char, user, group, description, personality, scenario, mesExamples. No variables, scripts or nested evaluation.
compat.lore: Advanced lore or regex detected. Only the bounded regex subset is supported. Unsupported entries stay inactive; inspect context for reasons.
writing.title: Writing settings
writing.hint: Changes generation instructions for this story only, not original cards or committed facts. New stories start fresh; branches and full saves retain these settings.
writing.formatHint: Uses our ocw-writing format, not full SillyTavern prompts or scripts. No API configuration. Save after choosing/importing to apply to this story.
writing.noteHint: Frequency counts user inputs. Depth counts retained messages. Native Claude merges system messages, so history placement cannot be guaranteed.
writing.quickHint: Buttons fill the composer for editing and sending. No scripts or automatic model calls.
writing.label: Button label
writing.macros: Supported double-brace macros: char, user, group, description, personality, scenario, mesExamples. No variables, scripts or nested evaluation.
error.invalidPreset: Invalid preset. Use an ocw-writing file.
error.presetLimit: Up to 50 presets. Remove an unused preset first.
